shortDescription: Offline CBT practice for JAMB UTME, WAEC and your own question papers.
fullDescription:
FocalPoint CBT is a study app from Wealth Consort for secondary-school students and older learners.

Prepare for JAMB UTME and WAEC with timed CBT practice, past questions and topic revision. Download available subjects and papers, choose what to study, and work at your own pace.

STUDY OFFLINE
Use downloaded papers, saved sessions and question working without an internet connection.

WORK THROUGH QUESTIONS
Swipe between questions. Use the movable calculator and expandable writing board, then revisit the working saved with each question. Written and theory questions retain their numbered parts.

REVIEW YOUR PROGRESS
Review answers, saved sessions and topic results to choose what to practise next. Written answers are for practice and self-review.

BRING YOUR OWN PAPERS
Upload permitted photos, PDFs, Word or PowerPoint documents, or question text. Review the prepared questions and save them for normal practice.

Use your own papers for Post-UTME, JUPEB, IJMB, SAT, 100-level university courses and other subjects or exams. These study uses rely on materials you provide; they are not a claim that ready-made question banks for each exam are included.

Sign-in, new downloads, uploads, question processing and account synchronisation require internet access. Downloaded practice works offline.

FocalPoint CBT is an independent study app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by WAEC, JAMB, College Board or other examination bodies.
